instruction: A non-degenerate triangle has integer side lengths. Its perimeter is 12 and its longest side is 6. What is the product of the lengths of the other two sides? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
